meta.name: agent-factory
meta.description: Claude Code agent generation system that creates custom agents and sub-agents with enhanced YAML frontmatter, tool access patterns, and MCP integration support following proven production patterns

copy.tagline: 创建自定义 agent 和 sub-agent，集成 MCP 工具
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成带 MCP 集成的 Claude Code agent
copy.tagline_en: Create custom agents and sub-agents with MCP integration
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate Claude Code agents with MCP support

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 这个技能会帮你生成自定义的 Claude Code 智能体文件。你只需提供名称、领域、工具等参数，它就会输出一个格式完整的 .md 文件，Claude Code 能自动发现并调用这个智能体。
howto.when: 当你需要为特定领域（如前端、后端、测试）创建专用智能体，或想快速搭建多个相关智能体时触发。
howto.what_en: This skill helps you generate custom Claude Code agent files. You provide name, domain, tools, etc., and it outputs a complete .md file that Claude Code can automatically discover and invoke.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create a specialized agent for a specific domain (e.g., frontend, backend, testing) or want to quickly scaffold multiple related agents.

say_en.text: Create an agent named api-integration-specialist, type Implementation, domain backend.
say_en.note: Generates a .md file for a backend API integration agent.

say_en.text: Generate a test agent named test-runner, type Quality, domain testing.
say_en.note: Generates a .md file for a test runner agent.
